items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: We want to pay you something for Arthur, too.

ctx.x: You know that block. The block is this is the other part. He had this made to put in a paper. Yes. And I'm trying to think. And the boy that took this cut, he worked in the perfect place. And he made just a bunch of them. And he gave me the other cut. She took that cut away from me. She grabbed everything. She managed to do that. I don't think she threw it away. But you said you made several copies of the film. Oh, yeah. Several copies. I got one or two back there. I know you. She gave me that.

She gave me that. We have this couple of weeks. We want to pay you something for Arthur, too. Yeah, you can't have that room because I got some information. We appreciate it. It's a wonderful picture to have. That's it.
That is him. That is him. Yeah. Yeah. That is him. Well, I tell you.
